description:
Verify whether completed work meets a task specification using AI.

Call get_fees() first to get the current fee amount and accepted assets.
Each fee_hash is single-use (anti-replay protection).

Response shape (always check criteria_failed before deciding how to proceed):

    {
      "verdict":         "PASS" | "FAIL",
      "status":          "approved" | "rejected",
      "score":           0-100,
      "summary":         "one-sentence explanation",
      "details":         "full reasoning",
      "criteria_met":    ["criterion A passed", "criterion B passed"],
      "criteria_failed": ["criterion C not met — specific reason"],
      "model_used":      "gemini-2.5-flash"
    }

On PASS: proceed to payment or accept the deliverable.
On FAIL: read criteria_failed to understand exactly what was missing.
  Each entry is a specific, actionable failure — not a generic rejection.
  Use them to tell the worker precisely what to fix before resubmitting.

fee_hash.description: Transaction hash of the fee payment. For XRP: 64-char hex of an XRPL Payment tx. For USDC on Base: 0x-prefixed 66-char EVM tx hash. Each hash is single-use.
fee_hash.title: XRPL Payment Hash

require_consensus.description: When True, two AI models must independently agree before returning PASS. Recommended for high-stakes tasks.

task.description: The task requirements or specification the worker must meet.
task.title: Task Specification

task_category.description: Evaluation rubric. One of: default, creative, code, data, data_analysis, bug_bounty, legal, supply_chain.

work.description: The work, output, or proof of completion to evaluate against the specification.
work.title: Completed Work
